name: Love x Sus ~Ai to Yokubou no Yakata~
original_name: ラブ×サス～愛と欲望の館～
source:
13 men and women trapped in a Western hotel on an island. 
You are roped into a cruel game.

Trapped on a land full of strangers. In this situation filled with distrust, the one who appeared in front of you was—

Why do you know me!? 
In this dangerous situation, you share a secret with the handsome man that wants to protect you. 
Trapped in an inescapable room, will you be able to live on with him—?!?

[from [url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/post/152699440166/lustinterrormanor]English Otome Games[/url]]
translation:
13名男女被困在一座岛上的一家西方酒店中。
你被卷入了一场残酷的游戏。

被困在一片充满陌生人的土地上。在这种充满不信任的情况下，出现在你面前的人是——

你为什么认识我！？
在这种危险的情况下，你与想要保护你的英俊男人分享了一个秘密。
被困在无法逃脱的房间里，你能和他一起生活吗——？！？

[来自[url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/post/152699440166/lustinterrormanor]English Otome Games[/url]]
